Near the upper-left intersection is labeled 4x°, near the middle intersection is labeled 56°, and near the lower-right intersection is labeled (3y−11)°. The problem only asks to find x, so the lower-right (3y−11)° does not need to be used. Then reason: When parallel lines are cut by the same transversal, the 4x° and 56° in the figure form same-side interior angles, that is, a pair of supplementary angles, so 4x+56=180. Thus 4x=124, x=31.
